# AI-DLC Project Instructions

This project is governed by the AI-DLC control plane. Organization policy is enforced in CI (`bitbucket-pipelines.yml`), not by these instructions — treat everything below as guidance, not the actual guardrail.

## Runtime prerequisite

The AI-DLC CLI and MCP extra must be installed in the environment used by VS Code:

```bash
pip install "ai-dlc[mcp]"
ai-dlc --help
```

Use the organization's configured package index or install the same AI-DLC version from its approved source. Restart the AI-DLC MCP server after installation or upgrade.

## Agent routing
